Name: QuTech
Description:
At QuTech, we work on a radically new technology with world-changing potential. Our mission: to develop scalable prototypes of a quantum computer and an inherently safe quantum internet, based on the fundamental laws of quantum mechanics.

Established by TU Delft and the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research TNO, the focus at QuTech currently covers nearly all facets of quantum computing, including theoretical physics, new materials, quantum coding, and the actual development of (components of) a quantum computer.

Name: NT-MDT B.V.
Description:
Nanotechnology is exploding. The world of small sizes has never been as vital for so many directions in science and industry. With this new direction comes a greater need for measurement on the atomic scale and new demands for reliable, precise, and multi-purpose instrumentation. NT-MDT enjoys a 30-year history in instrumentation created specifically for nanotechnology research, leading the field in originality, quality, and high tech development.
We strive for next-generation SPM technology, whether it be in pure modularity that allows a university or industrial lab to start with a cost-effective core product and build to a grand, multi-user research center or the ultimate amalgamation of SPM with related technologies that has resulted in ultramicrotomy for nanotomography and spectroscopy-based instruments that meld the world of imaging with the world of chemical analysis. We believe passionately in pushing the envelope for rapid innovation while still delivering superb customer service.

NT-MDT offers expert service and applications development through more than 20 representative offices and distributor centers around the globe. In the past years, our installed base has grown to over 1000 instruments, promoting growth of both lab and research programs world-wide.

Whether you are engaged every day in nano research or just contemplating it, coupling your specific scientific knowledge and expertise with our competence in instrument creation will produce the highest quality research results currently available.

Mission
Our mission is to enable researchers, engineers and developers to conduct nanoscale research by creating ever more perfect nanotechnology instrumentation. Along the way, we maintain a global perspective, always taking into consideration the needs of student in the classroom, the researcher at the cutting edge in the laboratory, and the practicalities of industrial R&D.

Geweldig schoonmaken, 
zonder chemie.

Werken met de kracht van natuur en nanobubble technologie; zeer effectief schoonmaken, desinfecteren, ontgeuren en afspoelen.

Ozonwater. Gemaakt van het water wat we drinken en de lucht die we ademen.

Verlaag je kosten en help tegelijkertijd mee aan een schonere wereld.

Ozonwater is een natuurlijke, krachtige schoonmaak- en desinfectievloeistof gemaakt van water en zuurstof (O2) en wordt ter plekke (on-site) gemaakt met behulp van nanobubble technologie. Dit zorgt er voor dat je je gebruik van chemie flink kunt minderen. Ozonwater is zeer ecologisch verantwoord en laat géén chemisch residu achter. Er blijft na schoonmaak of desinfectie niks achter op zuurstof en water na.

Ozonwater is veilig voor mens, dier en natuur. Je hebt geen PPE (beschermingsmiddelen) nodig om er mee te werken.

Meer informatie; https://ozongreen.nl/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/10_Redenen.pdf

Een greep uit de resultaten: https://ozongreen.nl/resultaten/

Name: IPS Materials
Description:
IPS Materials is an independently operating full-service coating company and strategic partner of Emisshield in Europe. We serve high energy consuming industries directly to improve their energy efficiency. We build partnerships with companies providing energy saving solutions to their customers to protect a sustainable future.

Emisshield is the third generation of high emissivity ceramic coating originally design by NASA to protect space vehicles used in space exploration. Emisshield is a thin filmed, space certified ceramic coating with high emissivity and heat re-radiation capabilities extending over a wide temperature range up to 1,700°C (3,100°F). The Emisshield technology positively impacts most heat applications by changing the base physics of any system, and thus allows for positive improvements on any heat generating or absorbing structure. Emisshield High-Emissivity coatings are proven solution based products that provide energy savings, production increases, downtime reductions, increased material life and lower air emissions.

Name: NX Filtration
Description:
NX Filtration is a fast-growing company that develops and manufactures hollow fiber membranes and modules for use in ultrafiltration and hollow fiber nanofiltration applications. The low fouling, chlorine tolerant hollow fiber construction provides removal of organics, e.g., micro-pollutants, and salinity.

NX Filtration’s technology is ideally suited for waste water re-use applications and for polishing of surface water to drinking water standards. Other applications include decentralized water treatment, color removal, softening, and partial desalination for industrial, process and municipal applications.

The membrane products of NX Filtration are capable of producing drinking water from surface or waste water.

Name: Single Quantum
Description:
Light detectors are crucial components of optical imaging and telecommunication systems. The ultimate photon detector is capable of detecting the elementary particle of light, a single photon.

Founded in 2012, Single Quantum was a pioneer in developing, manufacturing and commercializing the ground-breaking technology of superconducting single photon detectors. Single Quantum provides the best performance in photon detection, enabling the most demanding optical applications. 

Our multi-channel detection system has  already been chosen by more than 250 academic and industrial customers all over the world to perform complex optical measurements. The unique combination of unparalleled detection efficiency and time resolution makes our superconducting detectors the ideal choice for quantum communication and cryptography, infrared fluorescence spectroscopy, and laser ranging.

If you want to learn more about our products or if you are interested in joining our team, please visit www.singlequantum.com or contact us via info@singlequantum.com.

Name: Quantum Internet Alliance (QIA)
Description:
Quantum Internet Alliance (QIA) is a consortium of 42 world-leading institutions working together to build a global Quantum Internet made in Europe. By combining QIA’s diverse interdisciplinary team, we will establish an innovative European platform for Quantum Internet development and build a full-stack prototype network that has the potential to become the first of its kind in the world. 

Led by QuTech, QIA consists of academic institutions, telecom operators, system integrators and quantum technology start-ups across nine (9) European countries. It is currently co-funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under grant number 101102140.

Name: VSPARTICLE
Description:
Every breakthrough in human history begins with materials. At VSParticle, we accelerate the development and scaling of advanced materials that power our customers’ real-world solutions.

We are a Dutch company specializing in nanoparticle synthesis and nanoporous layer deposition. 
Using our patented spark ablation technology, we provide tools and deposition services that allow research and industrial R&D teams to generate high-purity nanoparticles directly from bulk metals and to form binder-free nanoporous layers across metals, alloys, and metal oxides. 

Our portfolio includes R&D equipment for nanoparticle synthesis and printing, as well as deposition services that deliver ready-to-use nanoporous layers on customer substrates.

Our solutions help clients speed up R&D, validate concepts, and shorten development cycles in electrocatalysis (PEMWE, CO2RR, HER, OER, N2RR), gas sensing (CO2, N2, CO, NH3, toluene, H2), and material discovery applications. The same capabilities can also support other applications where precise nanomaterials matter, including semiconductors, catalysis, health technologies, and other advanced applications. 

By bridging the gap from lab to fabrication, VSParticle enables faster material development, more controlled experimentation, and a scalable path toward next-generation device technologies and industrial applications.

Name: Optics11 Life
Description:
Mechanics matter the moment cells touch the well-plate. Optics11 Life equips life-science teams with fiber-optic instruments for real-time, non-destructive mechanical characterization of soft and living biomaterials; cells, hydrogels, spheroids, organoids, and tissues. These insights accelerate disease modeling, therapy development, and regenerative medicine.

Founded in 2011, we transformed a unique fiber-optic technology into lab-ready tools that quantify the mechanics of extremely soft, living samples, without disrupting biology. Our systems fit seamlessly into advanced labs, with easy operation, workflow integration, optical readouts, and control of physiological parameters.

What we offer:

PIUMA – Benchtop characterization of large tissues.

CHIARO – Microscope-compatible system for small tissue samples.

PAVONE – Screening-scale platform with automated indentation mapping, bright-field & fluorescence imaging, and environmental control.

CUORE – Automated contractility assays to grow and monitor musculoskeletal tissues.

Unlock the power of mechanobiology with us. Connect to learn how our solutions can advance your research.

Name: Delmic
Description:
Delmic is a passionate high-tech company based in Delft, the Netherlands that develops powerful and user-friendly solutions for electron microscopy, bringing researchers and organizations closer to research insights across diverse application fields.  

Integration of light and electron microscopy fundamentally impacts imaging by creating the possibility to gain deep insight quickly, easily and reliably. Delmic’s mission is to empower researchers and companies by helping them achieve results that can be trusted implicitly with powerful and user-friendly solutions. Currently, Delmic has two main product lines: cathodoluminescence solutions (SPARC Spectral, SPARC Compact and JOLT) and correlative light and electron microscopy solutions (SECOM, SECOM SR, DELPHI). All the systems cater to a broad range of researchers in fields ranging from life science, geology, materials science to nanophotonics.

The company is currently working on two new projects: one is aimed to simplify the complex workflows involved in Cryo electron tomography; another project will help to increase imaging speed without sacrificing image quality with an automated multibeam scanning electron microscope.

At Delmic, we believe that imaging provides a fundamental understanding of systems and is an integral part of creating a better world, therefore we aim to continuously innovate in order to offer our customers powerful insights and make research easy with simple workflows.

Name: DENSsolutions

Using MEMS-based sample carriers, DENSsolutions upgrades your TEM into a laboratory for nanotechnology that unveils the evolutionary nanoscale dynamics of your sample. With our dedicated technology, software and service, we support you from sample management to data analysis, promising reliability and accuracy every time.

Name: E-magy
Description:
With climate change a key issue in the world today, electrification of mobility is rising fast. Restricted range, charging speed and cost are standing in the way of wide scale EV adoption. Today's batteries use graphite as an active anode material, whereas silicon has up to ten times more capacity. Until now, the transition to silicon was hindered because silicon can swell and break when charged.

At E-magy, we supply nano-porous silicon for high-energy batteries. Our unique specialty silicon overcomes the swelling challenge by containing the expansion within the nanopores themselves, as validated by ZSW, a leading institute for applied battery research. We make high-energy silicon-dominant anodes a reality, compatible with existing production lines and are ready to scale up. 

Since 2013, we have been developing our solution in our cutting edge production facility near Amsterdam, The Netherlands. The team consists of driven, advanced materials specialists with over 20 years of silicon crystallisation experience. Cooperating with more than a dozen leading automotive and battery manufacturers, we bring our clients winning battery performance. We are part of multiple leading European battery associations and consortia to bring the industry forward. As ultimately, our dream is for everyone to enjoy the benefits of clean, electrically powered mobility.

E-magy. On with silicon
Location: Broek op Langedijk, North Holland, Netherlands

Name: Flexiramics
Description:

Its activities are focused on its core invention: Flexiramics, a pure ceramic microfiber material that is light and flexible like paper but retains the main physiochemical properties of traditional ceramics. The most important properties of ceramics are heat resistance, electrical insulation and resistance to corrosion.

All Flexiramics products have the unique and novel characteristics of being pure ceramic and being flexible at the same time. The level of flexibility, density, the ceramic composition and the geometry of the material are just some of the parameters that can be customized based on our client’s needs. Flexiramics material shows strong potential as a versatile substrate reinforcement in electronics and semiconductors, while also offering effective
filtration media functionalities for separation and purification. It is suitable for catalytic support and structural reinforcement, enhancing strength and
performance in various industrial applications.
Furthermore, the material can serve as an efficient battery separator in energy storage and as a thermal interface material for both insulation and
heat management solutions.

Name: Kalpana Systems
Description:
What if you could accelerate the energy transition thanks to a new perspective on atomic layer deposition for thin films?   

Imagine batteries with next-level performance, unrivalled range and fast charging. Imagine affordable flexible solar panels and OLED screens for unrestricted designs. Imagine fully recyclable packaging, thanks to ultra-thin barrier coatings. We found a way to solve the challenges of applying ALD technology to thin films. We like to call it: Superspatial ALD.   

Inspired by the helical design found in nature, our technology provides an elegant solution to break from industry standards. Superspatial ALD enables the deposition of complex multi-layers in just one production step. The unique helical web transport in our thin film machine enables the roll-to-roll production of coating layers at high throughput.   

Superspatial ALD speeds up the ALD process by 1000 times, reducing cost by a factor of 10, using precious materials with the precision of a single atom. All with one machine, adaptable to fit different substrate types and widths, with a small footprint that seamlessly integrates into your production line.   

The wait is over. Superspatial ALD is finally here.

Description:
Welcome to our NanoComputing Research Lab, where we delve into materials, devices, and circuits to pioneer energy-efficient computing solutions.

Our core expertise are in device physics, circuit design, physical design, design space exploration and optimization methods for the design of energy efficient circuits and architectures. 

Over the years, we have widened my research scope to cover material and device fabrication and characterisation combined with circuit and IC design to investigate novel computing paradigms such as physical computing, neuromorphic computing and monolithic 3D integration. 

Additionally, we apply circuit design techniques in quantum computing for quantum circuit design such as transpilation, error mitigation and fault tolerance. By combining my knowledge and expertise in diverse areas, we strive to contribute to the advancement of nanotechnology and drive innovation in the field of nanoscale devices and computing architectures.

Head of NanoComputing Research Lab is Prof. A. C. Todri-Sanial, TU/e

Name: MapMetrics
Description:
Maps aren’t just roads and routes—they’re living directories of places, people, and experiences. MapMetrics captures that rich metadata layer by empowering anyone to contribute granular details: store hours that actually match reality, wheelchair‐friendly entrances, seasonal menus, pet‐friendly patios, pop‐up markets, and community events. Each micro‐update is verified through a consensus model and rolled out worldwide in minutes, keeping our dataset perpetually fresh.

We built MapMetrics because the world changes faster than legacy mapping giants can keep up. Traditional map providers rely on slow, top‐down data pipelines; by the time an update appears, it’s often stale. MapMetrics flips the model: local contributors supply updates in real time, retain full ownership and privacy over their data, and see direct recognition for their input. Meanwhile, developers, cities, and businesses access this dynamic metadata via powerful APIs, unlocking smarter local search, personalized recommendations, and agile smart‐city applications.

Our mission is simple: make location data as responsive as the communities it represents—open, accurate, privacy-first, and owned by the people who know their neighborhoods best.

Name: Occam Dx
Description:

Thanks to our patented nano-electronic biosensor, we are able to detect even one single virus or bacterium, resulting in unprecedented sensitivity. We identify the targeted  pathogen and disregard other components in the sample, for superior specificity. This gives you better insights to make the right diagnosis and determine the correct regimen.

The test is performed as close as possible to the patient. The data is brought as close as possible to the clinician, through the cloud. This ensures a secure mode of communication between the medical professional in the ER, OR, ICU and GP’s office and the microbiologist in the lab.

We significantly reduced the logistical complexity of a diagnosis. Less hands-on time, easy-to-use for all practitioners, online accessible, resulting in an effective and cost efficient procedure.

Name: Ultrafast Magnetism Conference (UMC)
Description:
The Ultrafast Magnetism Conference (UMC) is a long-standing international conference series dedicated to the study of ultrafast spin and magnetization dynamics. UMC provides a leading forum for researchers working on dynamic processes in magnetic materials on picosecond, femtosecond, and attosecond time scales, bringing together experts from academia, research institutes, and industry.

Since its inception, the UMC series has been hosted in major research centers across Europe, including Strasbourg, Nijmegen, Kaiserslautern, York, Nancy, and Berlin, reflecting the conference’s strong international character and its central role within the ultrafast magnetism community.

The scientific scope of UMC spans a broad range of topics, including ultrafast spin dynamics and magnetization switching, laser-induced magnetic phenomena, orbital angular momentum and phonon dynamics, ultrafast spin transport and devices, terahertz experiments and applications, antiferro- and altermagnets, two-dimensional, chiral, topological, and quantum materials, ultrafast magnetic microscopy and nanoscale dynamics, as well as novel experimental techniques and advanced theory and simulation.

In addition to its core program, UMC regularly features focused symposia and satellite meetings organized in collaboration with international research initiatives, fostering interdisciplinary exchange and highlighting emerging directions in ultrafast magnetism and related fields.
